text: DEFONEOS — DWP Employment Support Allowance Reforms AI Deep-Dive Pack EU AI Act Article 50 live 2 Aug 2026 — C2PA passport ready | Get yours → Home Master GovBench Index Sitemap DEFONEOS × DWP × ESA REFORMS DWP Employment Support Allowance Reforms AI Deep-Dive Pack Sovereign AI governance of UK ESA reform transition — new-style ESA, WRAG to LCW/LCWRA migration, UC transition protection, contribution-based assessment, and work capability reform. 12 entry points × 8 transformation priorities × 6 MCPs. Audit-grade. Signed. UK-sovereign. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 6 Red Lines 📋 12 Entry Points Assessment LCW/LCWRA Assessment — WCA AI for ESA WCA scoring against LCW and LCWRA descriptors. 15-point threshold for LCW. LCWRA categories — mobilising, continence, coping, substantial risk. Descriptors across physical, mental, cognitive, sensory functions. Majority of days rule. Terminal illness fast-track (SR1). WCA outcome routing to UC or ESA requirements. Mandatory reconsideration before appeal. Assessment provider management (Maximus/Capita). Risk-stratified reassessment. Eligibility Contribution-Based ESA — NI Contribution Test, New-Style ESA New-style ESA requiring Class 1 or Class 2 NI contributions. Two tax-year contribution window — Year 1 and Year 2. LEL sufficient contributions test. Credits-only exclusion from contribution-based ESA. Income-based ESA phased out in UC full-service areas. NI verification via HMRC RTI. Self-employed Class 2 route. Overlapping benefit rule with contributory JSA and IB. Migration UC Transition Protection — ESA to UC Managed Migration Managed migration under UC (Managed Migration Pilot and Rollout) Regulations 2019. Transitional protection — difference between ESA award and UC entitlement at migration. SDP gateway — SDP element added to UC transitional component. Erosion rules — no real-terms increase. Minimum 1-month notice. Legacy benefit termination on deadline. Natural migration detection on change of circumstances. Voluntary migration path. WRAG to UC LCW. Support to UC LCWRA. Work Groups WRAG to LCW — Work-Related Activity Group Transition ESA WRAG component (£90.50/wk) mapped to UC LCW element (nil after April 2017 for new claims). WRAG claimants with LCW descriptor migrating to UC with work-related requirements. WFI requirement carryover. Work preparation plan transfer. WRAG to LCWRA re-referral on health deterioration. 365-day contributory WRAG time-limiting. Permitted work carryover (£167/wk). Compliance and sanction transition. Safeguarding for complex needs. Enhanced Protection Support Group to LCWRA — Enhanced Protection Support Group migrating to UC LCWRA with enhanced transitional protection. LCWRA element (£416.19/mo) plus transitional top-up. No reassessment during managed migration. Descriptors mapped to LCWRA — mobilising, continence, coping, substantial risk. SR1 fast-track retaining LCWRA without WCA. 24-month reassessment protection. GP/consultant evidence preservation. Rights briefing. Overlapping disability benefit interaction (PIP, AA). Work Rules Permitted Work — Supported Work, Limits, Disregard Permitted work lower limit (£167/wk) — up to 16 hours/week. Higher limit (£183.50/wk) — LCW only, not LCWRA. Supported permitted work — no limit for supervised programme. ESA earnings disregard (£20/wk for WRAG). UC transition carryover. Therapeutic work exception. WFI trigger after 26 weeks. Supported employment accreditation. HMRC RTI verification. Fraud ESA Fraud Detection — Overpayment, Identity, Compliance Overpayment detection via HMRC RTI cross-match. DWP CIS identity verification. NI contribution fraud — fictitious employer flags. WCA fraud — inconsistent medical evidence and GP cross-check. Concurrent ESA/UC detection. Permitted work exceedance monitoring. Compliance interview trigger from analytics. Prosecution evidence chain. Civil penalty for negligent misrepresentation. Recovery from UC transitional protection. Digital Work Coach Digital
